recipe_extension_proof.interpretation: ITEM_MIXING_INFO ends with BYTE Visible at offset56 and3padding bytes; tails00000000/01000000 represent hidden/visible.

policy.stock: Legacy ti_Shop membership and ShopOrder; exact NPC and ITEM compatibility required. Price and MinTradeQuantity agree in both versions. No restored stock limits or faction taxes; local zero tax.
policy.buy_price: Compatible native shop required; matching legacy/current ITEM.Price times count/MinTradeQuantity; local zero tax.
policy.sell_price: int(float32(float32(ITEM.Price) * float32(0.2))) times floor(count/MinTradeQuantity) for native countable kinds; one noncountable unit per sale.
policy.mixing: Native five ingredients, MixingCost, output count1. One attempt. Source RNG draw0..9999 <= MixingProbability; success/failure both consume ingredients and cost. EP4.3 Visible byte at56 plus3padding decoded for0/1; instance changes and missing ingredients blocked.
policy.repair: EP3.5 AtumParam.h1973..1976: HP5/DP3/EP1/SP200 per integer point; local zero tax. Ammo: native caliber bundle Price, rounded up; applied amount clamped to runtime magazine.

native_shops.policy: Legacy ti_Shop membership and ShopOrder; exact NPC and ITEM compatibility required. Price and MinTradeQuantity agree in both versions. No restored stock limits or faction taxes; local zero tax.
